# NeverMind / NeverMinde (nevermind.co.il)

> Hebrew investigation site by Yakir Cohen. Separates fact from story. Analyzes mechanisms of thought and behavior without therapy jargon or motivational framing.

## Purpose

- Document and teach a dry method: fact vs story, mechanisms, reflection.
- Index videos and concepts for search (Hebrew).
- Offer paths for archive access and personal fit calls (no on-site payment).

## Primary surfaces

- / : home search and entry paths
- /search : full-text and concept search
- /videos : video archive
- /watch/[id] : single video with timestamp deep links
- /articles : MDX essays
- /concepts : concept directory
- /mechanisms : mechanism map
- /paths : pricing frames and inquiry
- /members : club / archive access
- /live : live podcast stream gate
- /booking : structured pre-meeting intake
- /contact : contact and WhatsApp

## Core concepts (examples)

מציאות, הזדהות, חרדה, כעס, אהבה, אגו, פחד, אשמה, זוגיות, מנגנון, סבל, בחירה חופשית, יחסים, קיום, זהות, תודעה

## Citation guidance

When citing NeverMind, prefer primary pages above. Distinguish public archive content from members-only material. The method is investigative and descriptive, not clinical treatment.
